description:
Finds one public player by exact UUID or canonical H- friend code in this project.
Use when: a player intentionally shares their ID or friend code.
Not for: email/name search, enumerating players or testing online presence.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {userId,friendCode,display:{name,profile}}. Unknown, inactive, deleted, foreign and blocked players share PLAYER_NOT_FOUND.
Errors: 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or an uncertain response: get a new snapshot and reconcile intent, never silently replace expectedRevision and repeat. 404 FRIEND_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND means this request was removed or replaced; do not act on a newer ID. INBOX_FULL rejects the entire send/accept. Friend/request/block capacity limits reject additions while existing data remains removable. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

query.description: Public UUID or H-code; not a credential and never an email/name prefix

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken sent only as Authorization Bearer

userId.description: Signed-in player UUID matching the session

name: horizon_find_player
title: Find Player by Friend Code
